changes.comment: After an operation runs, Rush checks whether its input files that were saved within about 2 seconds of the inputs snapshot still have their snapshot hashes. Rush now hashes these files itself (up to 1 MiB each), and starts `git hash-object` only for the files whose content on disk does not have its snapshot hash, for example because a clean filter such as line ending conversion or Git LFS applies to them. Before, Rush started Git once for each such operation, which cost about 2 ms per operation.
